title: HisabDo Help Center FAQ
heading: Is HisabDo free to use?
content:
## Is HisabDo free to use?

Yes. HisabDo is free to download and use from Google Play. Core features including khata management, customer accounts, PDF export and backup are available at no cost.

title: HisabDo Help Center FAQ
heading: Where can I download HisabDo?
content:
## Where can I download HisabDo?

HisabDo is available on Google Play. Search for "HisabDo" or use the download link on [hisabdo.app](https://hisabdo.app). It is available for free on Android devices.

title: HisabDo Help Center FAQ
heading: Who created HisabDo?
content:
## Who created HisabDo?

HisabDo was created by Mian Usman Khalid, a Pakistani software engineer and entrepreneur. He built the app to address the gap between enterprise financial tools and the practical needs of small shopkeepers and business owners across Pakistan and South Asia.

title: HisabDo Help Center FAQ
heading: How do I contact HisabDo support?
content:
## How do I contact HisabDo support?

You can reach us at hisabdo.app@gmail.com or through our [Contact page](https://hisabdo.app/contact). We aim to respond within 48 hours.

title: HisabDo Help Center FAQ
heading: Can I manage customers in HisabDo?
content:
## Can I manage customers in HisabDo?

Yes. You can create individual profiles for each customer with their name and contact details. Each customer has their own transaction history and running balance, so you can instantly see what they owe or have paid.

title: HisabDo Help Center FAQ
heading: Can I track receivables (money owed to me)?
content:
## Can I track receivables (money owed to me)?

Yes. HisabDo tracks money that customers owe you with a complete history of each transaction and the current outstanding balance. You can see all outstanding receivables at a glance.

title: HisabDo Help Center FAQ
heading: Can I use HisabDo without creating an account?
content:
## Can I use HisabDo without creating an account?

Yes. You can continue as a guest without creating an account. Supported local/offline functionality can be used without internet access, and local records remain available on your device.

title: HisabDo Help Center FAQ
heading: What happens when I sign in?
content:
## What happens when I sign in?

You can create or sign in to your HisabDo account. When you are signed in and connected to the internet, supported data can be synchronized with our Supabase cloud infrastructure.

title: HisabDo Help Center FAQ
heading: Does HisabDo support voice entry?
content:
## Does HisabDo support voice entry?

Yes. HisabDo includes voice entry support so you can create records by speaking rather than typing. This is especially useful in busy environments where typing is slow or disruptive.

title: Why We Built HisabDo

content:
## Record as You Go — Even by Voice

Each sale, payment, or expense is logged against the right customer as it happens. If your hands are full or you're mid-conversation with a customer, voice entry lets you record a transaction by speaking instead of typing.

content:

Analytics show income trends, expense patterns and how much is tied up in unpaid dues — the kind of overview that's nearly impossible to get from a paper register no matter how carefully it's kept.

title: The Complete Small Business Financial Management Guide
heading: How much time should I spend on financial management each week?
last_updated_basis: published date shown on the page
content:
## How much time should I spend on financial management each week?

For most small businesses, 30–45 minutes per week is sufficient for daily recording (5–10 minutes per day) plus a weekly review (15–20 minutes). The monthly review takes 30–60 minutes. The key is making it a consistent habit rather than an occasional task.

title: Cash Flow Management for Small Businesses: A Practical Guide
heading: Overview
last_updated_basis: published date shown on the page
content:
## Overview

Why profitable businesses run out of cash — and the practical habits that keep your cash position healthy month after month.

Cash flow is one of the most misunderstood concepts in small business finance. Many business owners focus entirely on sales and profit, assuming that if the business is profitable, cash will take care of itself. This assumption has caused the failure of many otherwise viable businesses.

The reality is that a business can be profitable on paper and still run out of cash. Understanding why this happens — and how to prevent it — is one of the most valuable financial skills a business owner can develop.

title: Why We Built HisabDo
heading: The Problem With Paper Khata
content:
## The Problem With Paper Khata

### Entries Get Lost

A torn page, a spilled drink, a misplaced register — years of customer history can disappear in seconds.

### No One Else Can Read It

Handwritten registers are often understood only by the shop owner, which becomes a problem when someone else needs to check a balance.

### Manual Totals Cause Errors

Adding up dozens of entries by hand, every single day, leaves plenty of room for small mistakes that add up over time.

### Nothing to Hand the Customer

When a customer asks "what do I owe you," there's no clean statement to give them — just a page they may not be able to read.

## Overview

Effective Date: September 24, 2026

HisabDo ("we", "our", or "us") values your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how the HisabDo mobile application ("App") and website collect, use, store, and protect your information.

By using the App, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

title: Privacy Policy
heading: 1. Information We Collect
last_updated_basis: effective date shown on the page
content:
## 1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following information when you use the App.

Account Information

When you create an account, we collect:

- Name (if provided)
- Email address
- Authentication credentials (managed securely by Supabase Authentication)

We do not store your password.

Business & Financial Data

When you use the App, you may create and store:

- Customer names, phone numbers, and email addresses
- Notes, income records, expense records, transaction amounts
- Categories, dates, images attached to transactions
- Business profile information

This information may be stored locally on your device. In signed-in mode, supported customer, income, and expense records may be synchronized with our cloud infrastructure through Supabase. The App does not claim that every locally stored category is synchronized to the cloud.

Device Information

The App may automatically collect limited technical information, including:

- Device model
- Operating system version
- App version
- Crash logs (if applicable)

This information is used only for improving app stability.

title: The Complete Small Business Financial Management Guide
heading: 1. Financial Management Basics
last_updated_basis: published date shown on the page
content:
## 1. Financial Management Basics

Financial management is the process of planning, organizing, controlling and monitoring your business's financial resources. For a small business, this means:

- Knowing how much money is coming in and going out
- Tracking what customers owe you and what you owe suppliers
- Maintaining accurate records of all transactions
- Reviewing your financial position regularly
- Making decisions based on actual financial data, not guesswork

Good financial management does not require an accounting degree. It requires consistency, discipline and the right tools.
